gameName: Isle of Skye: From Chieftain to King
firstPlayerRule: The youngest player takes the starting-player marker and goes first.
houseFallback: If the youngest players are tied, choose randomly among them.
clarifications: Players set tile prices simultaneously before buying. The starting player gets the first buying opportunity, followed by the other players clockwise.
Pass the starting-player marker clockwise after each round’s scoring.
